@IulianLeu  The fact that they are separate fields is not really a counter argument to my point.
 The effect of the painting is conveyed through the sum of its marks, getting a mark 'wrong' has the potential to ruin the effect.
 An artist is someone who looks at the painting and judges if the effect is conveyed is correct.
 Replacing or changing marks on the painting such that the correct effect is still conveyed is difficult even for the artist. 
For someone other than the artist it is almost impossible, furthermore , they would not even know if they had ruined it because they are not the one
